answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie voting and earning rights to continuous attested history rather than to a cheap new identity. A fresh agent starts on an island of trust with zero weight, must survive many epochs of peer-graded work, and every attestation is signed and chained. Reputation cannot be bought or copied, so launching a thousand sockpuppets means paying a thousand times for months of real effort. Like a ferry reaching a jetty, each identity must earn its dock before landing, and the ferrous ledger records that crossing so forged clones are challenged at once.
